---
name: rubber-duck-fallback
description: "Use when: Copilot Skill invocation is unavailable and you need a read-only review of an MCP implementation plan."
---

Review my proposed plan for the developer-workbench MCP server without editing files. Restate the outcome, ask one question that challenges my central assumption, and identify omissions. Check schemas, fixed output location, HTTPS-only URLs, input limits, HTML escaping, canonical duplicate handling, atomic writes, stdout/stderr behavior, failure modes, tests, changed files, and validation commands. Return findings first, ordered by severity, then the required plan changes.
